_comment: Bypass techniques for when a probe is blocked by a defense (WAF, filter/sanitizer, auth gate, rate-limit). Look up the matching defense and apply the technique instead of giving up.

techniques.name: Encoding
techniques.how: URL-encode, double-encode, or unicode-escape the payload so the signature never matches.

techniques.name: Case variation
techniques.how: Alternate keyword case to evade case-sensitive signatures.

techniques.name: Inline comments
techniques.how: Insert inline comments inside keywords to split the signature.

techniques.name: Separator variation
techniques.how: Swap spaces for tabs/newlines/alternative separators.

techniques.name: String concatenation
techniques.how: Break the payload into concatenated fragments.

techniques.name: Chunked / HTTP smuggling
techniques.how: Split the payload across chunked-encoding or HTTP/2 boundaries to bypass inspection.

techniques.name: Parameter pollution
techniques.how: Send duplicate parameters; the WAF checks one, the app uses the other.

techniques.name: Null byte
techniques.how: Insert a null byte to truncate validation while the sink reads past it.

techniques.name: Double encoding
techniques.how: Encode twice; the filter decodes once, the sink decodes again.

techniques.name: Unicode / normalization
techniques.how: Use fullwidth, overlong UTF-8, or unicode lookalikes the filter misses.

techniques.name: Case mixing
techniques.how: Bypass blacklists with mixed case when the filter is case-sensitive.

techniques.name: Whitespace / padding
techniques.how: Insert spaces/tabs/newlines the filter strips or ignores.

techniques.name: Nested / recursive
techniques.how: Nest a blocked token inside an allowed one so the filter strips one layer.

techniques.name: Cast / length truncation
techniques.how: Exploit int cast or length truncation that drops the dangerous tail.

techniques.name: HTTP verb tampering
techniques.how: Switch the method (GET->POST) or fuzz uncommon verbs (TRACE, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, INVENTED, HACK) + X-HTTP-Method-Override.

techniques.name: Proxy header spoofing
techniques.how: Spoof a proxy-origin header to appear internal/localhost; each proxy honors a different one.
techniques.example: X-Originating-IP, X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded, Forwarded-For, X-Remote-IP, X-Remote-Addr, X-ProxyUser-Ip, Client-IP, True-Client-IP, Cluster-Client-IP, Host: localhost, X-Original-URL: /admin, X-Rewrite-URL: /admin

techniques.name: Path normalization
techniques.how: Bypass path-based ACL with traversal, encoding, case, suffix, or separator tricks.

techniques.name: API version confusion
techniques.how: Hit a legacy or different API version that lacks the authorization check.

techniques.name: Parameter override / pollution
techniques.how: Override auth via a second param, or pollute a JSON field with a duplicate key.

techniques.name: Protocol / host confusion
techniques.how: Switch http<->https, drop the Host header, or contact the origin IP/CNAME directly.
techniques.example: https://host -> http://host; remove Host header; resolve CNAME to origin

techniques.name: IP / header rotation
techniques.how: Rotate source IP or spoof client headers to evade per-IP limits.

techniques.name: Low-and-slow
techniques.how: Stay under the threshold with pacing + jitter.

techniques.name: Header spoofing
techniques.how: Spoof User-Agent / Referer to look like a real browser.

techniques.name: Token/session reuse
techniques.how: Reuse a valid session/token across requests to skip per-request checks.

techniques.name: Burst vs window
techniques.how: Exploit the difference between per-second and per-window limits.
